profile.org_note: Esperanza Homes is the homebuilding division of family-owned Rhodes Enterprises, a vertically integrated South Texas developer (land development, homebuilding, rental homes, commercial, property management, mortgage). Leadership is published only at the parent level: land sits with EVP of Land Development Brad Frisby and finance with VP Finances Sergio Pena, both under President / CEO Nick Rhodes. Division names (McAllen, Mid-Valley, Laredo, Corpus Christi) come from the group's job board; no division leaders are published. Legal entity name and 2006 incorporation are from a public-records aggregator; the Esperanza site says founded 2007 and the Rhodes site says 2006.
profile.summary: South Texas builder (724 closings in 2025 per the Builder 100) that is the in-house homebuilder of family-owned master developer Rhodes Enterprises. Most communities sit inside Rhodes master plans (Tres Lagos 2,567 acres, Bentsen Palm 2,600 acres, La Sienna 726 acres) on land the family has held since the 1990s, so it is a developer-builder that self-supplies lots rather than a lot buyer. Builds across the Rio Grande Valley and Laredo, is opening in Corpus Christi (Mirabella, about 300 acres and 1,150 homes), and the parent targets 1,000 closings a year by 2027.
